column5: tiny magic hit: the diamond spark flashes bigger, splits into four small diamond shards flying outward, then fades out completely
fire hit: the flame flower bursts open wider, petals turn into embers flying outward and burn out to nothing
frost hit: the ice crystal shatters, sharp shards fly outward and shrink, then vanish completely
electric hit: the discharge flickers and crackles, branches jump to new zigzag shapes, then the sparks fade out
hellfire pillar erupts: the flame column shoots up taller, flickers, then collapses down into embers and disappears
glacier spikes burst up out of the ground, glint, then crack and crumble into small ice chunks that fade
magic orb projectile flying: the orb pulses and its sparkle tail flickers, same position and size every frame
fireball flying: the flames flicker and the tail ripples, same position and size every frame
hellfire comet flying: the jagged flames writhe and the ragged tail flickers, same position and size every frame
diamond magic nova explosion: the diamond burst expands outward, the concentric diamond outlines spread and thin, then break into sparkles and fade away
the nested diamond crystals crack and shatter into angular fragments that fly outward and fade
seamless looping flat magic circle on the ground: the rune marks rotate slowly around the ring and glow, same size and shape every frame
seamless looping burning meteor: the flames around the rock flicker and the fire tail ripples, rock stays in the same position
explosion dome: the fire dome bursts up bigger, smoke rolls outward, then the dome collapses leaving a glowing lava pool on the ground that cools down
lava splash: molten blobs and rock chunks fly up and outward, fall down and splatter into small glowing puddles that cool and fade
seamless looping fire tornado: the flame spiral spins and twists continuously, same size and position every frame
fire flower blooms: the flame petals open wider and flare, then curl and burn out into embers
swirling fire hit: the whirlpool of embers spins faster and spreads outward, then the flame streaks fade away
seamless looping blizzard: the snow streaks and hailstones move diagonally down to the right, same density every frame
ice crystal cluster: the crystals burst up out of the ground and glint, then cracks spread through them and they shatter into falling shards
lightning claw hand: the electric fingers crackle and flicker, then the hand clenches into a fist, sparks bursting from it
seamless looping storm cloud: the dark cloud churns slowly and the rain streaks fall, same size and position every frame
ground shockwave ring expands outward wider and thinner along the floor, then fades out
the cracked red sun glows hotter, the cracks widen with white light, then it splits apart into burning fragments flying outward
wall of white fire crashes forward and breaks over the ground, flames spread low and wide, then burn out
seamless looping night scene: the aurora ribbons in the sky wave and shimmer slowly, the mountains stay completely still
giant snowflake glints and pulses with light, then cracks and shatters into glass shards flying outward
ice crystals grow up taller encasing everything, glint, then crack and shatter into shards falling down
thunder god giant: lightning crackles through his beard and eyes flash, then he raises his arm and strikes down with a huge bolt of lightning
seamless looping lightning throne: the electric bolts forming the throne crackle and flicker, same shape every frame
crown lightning strike: the bolt slams down, the crown of zigzag prongs flares wide with a bright flash, then the lightning fades out
